title: XXE
description: Direct file read when output is echoed; OOB exfiltration when there is no echo
detail:
With echo: <!ENTITY x SYSTEM "file:///flag">
Parameter entity + out-of-band exfiltration (no echo): define %all; %send; in evil.dtd
SSRF combination: read file:///etc/hosts to map the internal network, then pivot to SSRF.
Supported points: uploading svg/xlsx/docx (embedded XML), SOAP endpoints, Content-Type: text/xml.
